hook: The school has no such pupil.

excerpt.text: ‘We don’t have a pupil called Ellie,’ he said.

excerpt: Not in any year. Not Eleanor, not Ella, not Elise.
‘She comes out with your children,’ Lorna said. ‘Every day. At quarter past three.’
caption:
Every afternoon a little girl crosses Lorna’s road. Then the school tells her they have no such pupil.
